form.label: Zeek Traffic Analysis - Overview
form.description: Baselining and first-look triage for a PCAP processed by Zeek. Pick a case, keep the time range on All time, then read the sections top to bottom.

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval src_scope=case(match(id_orig_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_orig_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | eval dst_scope=case(match(id_resp_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_resp_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | stats min(ts) as first max(ts) as last count as conns dc(eval(if(src_scope="internal",id_orig_h,null()))) as int_hosts dc(eval(if(dst_scope="external",id_resp_h,null()))) as ext_ips sum(eval(if(dst_scope="external",orig_bytes,0))) as ext_out sum(eval(if(dst_scope="external",resp_bytes,0))) as ext_in

index=$idx$ $case$ (sourcetype=zeek:conn OR sourcetype=zeek:ssl OR sourcetype=zeek:http) (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval dst_scope=case(match(id_resp_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_resp_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | where dst_scope="external" | eval name=case(sourcetype="zeek:ssl", server_name, sourcetype="zeek:http", mvdedup(host)) | stats count(eval(sourcetype="zeek:conn")) as conns dc(id_orig_h) as clients values(id_resp_p) as ports values(name) as names sum(orig_bytes) as out sum(resp_bytes) as in min(ts) as first max(ts) as last by id_resp_h | eval out_KB=round(out/1024,1), in_KB=round(in/1024,1), names=mvindex(names,0,4)

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:dns $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | where isnotnull(query) | eval q=lower(query) | stats count as queries dc(id_orig_h) as clients values(id_orig_h) as srcs values(qtype_name) as types values(rcode_name) as rcodes values(answers) as answers min(ts) as first max(ts) as last by q | eval answers=mvindex(answers,0,3)

input.label: Time range (All time for old PCAPs)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn | stats count by pcap_case | eval filter="pcap_case=\"".pcap_case."\"" | sort pcap_case

div.p: How to use: 1) choose a Case and keep Time range = All time. 2) Read sections A to J in order - A to C are the baseline (what is normal here), D to I look for what does not fit. 3) Type an IP in Host IP to focus every panel on one host. 4) Click a row with a uid in section J to see every Zeek log of that connection. Times are UTC if your Splunk time zone preference is UTC. Guide: DFIR Handbook - Blue Team - Splunk - Traffic Analysis Dashboards.

search.query: | eval v=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | fields v
| eval v=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | fields v
| eval v=round((last-first)/60,1) | fields v
| fields conns
| fields int_hosts
| fields ext_ips
| eval v=round(ext_out/1024/1024,2) | fields v
| eval v=round(ext_in/1024/1024,2) | fields v
| stats count as v
index=$sidx$ sourcetype=snort:alert $case$ (src_ip="$ip$" OR dest_ip="$ip$") | stats count as v

panel.title: B1. Zeek log types in this case (Host IP filter not applied)

search.query: index=$idx$ $case$ | stats count by sourcetype | sort - count

panel.title: B2. Connections by service (what Zeek recognised)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | fillnull value="(not recognised)" service | stats count by service | sort - count

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval state=case(conn_state="SF","SF - opened and closed normally", conn_state="S0","S0 - no reply", conn_state="REJ","REJ - rejected", conn_state="S1","S1 - open, never closed", conn_state="S2","S2 - client closed, no server reply", conn_state="S3","S3 - server closed, no client reply", conn_state="RSTO","RSTO - client sent reset", conn_state="RSTR","RSTR - server sent reset", conn_state="RSTOS0","RSTOS0 - SYN then reset, no reply", conn_state="RSTRH","RSTRH - server SYN-ACK then reset", conn_state="SH","SH - SYN then FIN, no reply", conn_state="SHR","SHR - server SYN-ACK and FIN only", conn_state="OTH","OTH - no SYN seen (mid-stream)", true(), conn_state) | stats count by state | sort - count
index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | stats count by proto

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | fillnull value="(not recognised)" service | eval _time=ts | timechart span=$span$ limit=10 useother=t count by $conn_split$

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval dst_scope=case(match(id_resp_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_resp_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | fillnull value="-" service | stats count as conns dc(id_orig_h) as clients dc(id_resp_h) as servers values(service) as service values(dst_scope) as scope by id_resp_p proto | sort - conns

panel.title: C1. Internal hosts that start connections

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval src_scope=case(match(id_orig_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_orig_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | where src_scope="internal" | stats count as sessions dc(id_resp_h) as destinations dc(id_resp_p) as ports sum(orig_bytes) as sent sum(resp_bytes) as received min(ts) as first max(ts) as last values(orig_l2_addr) as mac by id_orig_h | eval sent_KB=round(sent/1024,1), received_KB=round(received/1024,1) | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table id_orig_h mac sessions destinations ports sent_KB received_KB first last | sort - sessions

panel.title: C2. Host identity - name, domain, users, MAC, OS hint

search.query: index=$idx$ $case$ (sourcetype=zeek:dhcp OR sourcetype=zeek:ntlm OR sourcetype=zeek:kerberos OR sourcetype=zeek:http) | eval ip=if(sourcetype="zeek:dhcp", coalesce(assigned_addr, client_addr, requested_addr), id_orig_h) | eval kc=mvindex(split(client,"/"),0), realm=mvindex(split(client,"/"),1) | eval hostname_seen=case(sourcetype="zeek:dhcp", host_name, sourcetype="zeek:ntlm", hostname, sourcetype="zeek:kerberos" AND like(kc,"%$$"), upper(rtrim(kc,"$$"))) | eval user_seen=case(sourcetype="zeek:ntlm" AND len(username)>0 AND NOT like(username,"%$$"), username."@".coalesce(domainname,"?"), sourcetype="zeek:kerberos" AND len(kc)>0 AND NOT like(kc,"%$$"), kc."@".coalesce(realm,"?")) | eval domain_seen=case(sourcetype="zeek:dhcp", domain, sourcetype="zeek:ntlm", domainname, sourcetype="zeek:kerberos", realm) | eval mac_seen=if(sourcetype="zeek:dhcp", mac, null()) | eval ua=if(sourcetype="zeek:http", user_agent, null()) | eval os_hint=case(match(ua,"Windows NT 10\.0"),"Windows 10/11", match(ua,"Windows NT 6\.3"),"Windows 8.1", match(ua,"Windows NT 6\.2"),"Windows 8", match(ua,"Windows NT 6\.1"),"Windows 7", match(ua,"Windows NT 6\.0"),"Windows Vista", match(ua,"Windows NT 5\.1"),"Windows XP", match(ua,"iPhone|iPad"),"iOS", match(ua,"Android"),"Android", match(ua,"Macintosh|Mac OS X"),"macOS", match(ua,"Linux"),"Linux") | where match(ip,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.)") | search ip="$ip$" | stats values(hostname_seen) as hostname values(domain_seen) as domain values(user_seen) as users values(mac_seen) as mac values(os_hint) as os_hint dc(ua) as user_agents values(sourcetype) as seen_in by ip | eval seen_in=replace(mvjoin(seen_in," "),"zeek:","") | sort ip

panel.title: C3. Internal servers and their roles (answered connections only)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval dst_scope=case(match(id_resp_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_resp_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | where dst_scope="internal" AND NOT (conn_state="S0" OR conn_state="REJ") | eval role=case(id_resp_p=53,"DNS", id_resp_p=67,"DHCP server", id_resp_p=88,"Kerberos - domain controller", id_resp_p=389,"LDAP - domain controller", id_resp_p=636,"LDAPS - domain controller", id_resp_p=3268,"Global Catalog - domain controller", id_resp_p=464,"Kerberos password change - DC", id_resp_p=135,"RPC endpoint mapper", id_resp_p=445,"SMB file sharing", id_resp_p=139,"NetBIOS session (old SMB)", id_resp_p=137,"NetBIOS name", id_resp_p=138,"NetBIOS datagram", id_resp_p=123,"NTP time", id_resp_p=80,"Web (HTTP)", id_resp_p=443,"Web (HTTPS)", id_resp_p=8080,"Web proxy or alt HTTP", id_resp_p=3128,"Web proxy", id_resp_p=25,"Mail (SMTP)", id_resp_p=587,"Mail submission", id_resp_p=110,"Mail (POP3)", id_resp_p=143,"Mail (IMAP)", id_resp_p=3389,"Remote Desktop (RDP)", id_resp_p=5985,"WinRM (HTTP)", id_resp_p=5986,"WinRM (HTTPS)", id_resp_p=22,"SSH", id_resp_p=21,"FTP", id_resp_p=1433,"MS SQL", id_resp_p=9100,"Printer (RAW)", id_resp_p=5355,"LLMNR name lookup", id_resp_p=1900,"SSDP discovery", id_resp_p=5353,"mDNS", true(),"port ".id_resp_p."/".proto) | stats dc(id_orig_h) as clients count as conns values(role) as roles by id_resp_h | eval roles=mvindex(roles,0,11) | sort - clients

panel.title: C4. DHCP - IP, MAC and host name handed out

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:dhcp $case$ | search client_addr="$ip$" OR assigned_addr="$ip$" OR requested_addr="$ip$" | sort 0 ts | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), msg_types=mvjoin(msg_types," ") | table time client_addr requested_addr assigned_addr mac host_name client_fqdn domain server_addr msg_types

panel.title: D1. External destinations - most connections first

search.query: | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table id_resp_h names ports conns clients out_KB in_KB first last | sort - conns

panel.title: D2. Rare external destinations (3 connections or fewer, one client)

search.query: | where conns<=3 AND clients=1 | sort first | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table first id_resp_h names ports conns out_KB in_KB

panel.title: D3. External traffic on unusual ports (not 80, 443, 53, 123)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval dst_scope=case(match(id_resp_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_resp_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | where dst_scope="external" AND NOT (id_resp_p=80 OR id_resp_p=443 OR id_resp_p=53 OR id_resp_p=123) | fillnull value="-" service | stats count as conns values(conn_state) as states sum(orig_bytes) as out sum(resp_bytes) as in min(ts) as first by id_orig_h id_resp_h id_resp_p proto service | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - conns

panel.title: D4. Beacon candidates - regular repeated connections (low jitter = more regular)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval dst_scope=case(match(id_resp_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_resp_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | where dst_scope="external" | sort 0 ts | streamstats current=f last(ts) as prev_ts by id_orig_h id_resp_h id_resp_p | eval gap=ts-prev_ts | stats count as conns avg(gap) as avg_gap stdev(gap) as sd_gap avg(orig_bytes) as avg_out min(ts) as first max(ts) as last by id_orig_h id_resp_h id_resp_p | where conns>=5 | eval jitter=round(sd_gap/avg_gap,2), avg_gap=round(avg_gap,1), sd_gap=round(sd_gap,1), avg_out=round(avg_out,0), span_min=round((last-first)/60,1) | sort jitter | table id_orig_h id_resp_h id_resp_p conns avg_gap sd_gap jitter avg_out span_min

panel.title: D5. Most data sent to external (KB) - exfiltration check

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval dst_scope=case(match(id_resp_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_resp_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | where dst_scope="external" | stats sum(orig_bytes) as out sum(resp_bytes) as in by id_orig_h id_resp_h | sort - out | head 10 | eval pair=id_orig_h." > ".id_resp_h, KB_sent=round(out/1024,1), KB_received=round(in/1024,1) | table pair KB_sent KB_received

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | where isnotnull(duration) | sort - duration | head 25 | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), minutes=round(duration/60,1) | table time id_orig_h id_resp_h id_resp_p proto service minutes orig_bytes resp_bytes conn_state uid

panel.title: D7. External connections over time (top 10 destinations)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval dst_scope=case(match(id_resp_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_resp_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | where dst_scope="external" | eval _time=ts | timechart span=$span$ limit=10 useother=t count by id_resp_h
index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:dns $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | fillnull value="(none)" qtype_name | stats count by qtype_name | sort - count
index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:dns $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | fillnull value="(no reply)" rcode_name | stats count by rcode_name | sort - count

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:dns $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval dst_scope=case(match(id_resp_h,"^(22[4-9]|23[0-9]|255)\.|\.255$$|^ff"),"multicast/broadcast", match(id_resp_h,"^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|127\.|169\.254\.|0\.0\.0\.0$$|fe80:|fc|fd)"),"internal", true(),"external") | stats count as queries dc(id_orig_h) as clients by id_resp_h id_resp_p dst_scope | sort - queries
| sort queries, first | head 100 | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table q queries clients types rcodes answers first

panel.title: E5. Names in the order they were first looked up

search.query: | sort first | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N") | table first q srcs queries types rcodes answers

panel.title: E6. Odd names - long, many labels, TXT/NULL type or NXDOMAIN

search.query: | eval len=len(q), labels=mvcount(split(q,".")), t=mvjoin(types," "), r=mvjoin(rcodes," ") | where len>=40 OR labels>=6 OR match(t,"TXT|NULL") OR match(r,"NXDOMAIN") | sort - len | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table q len labels queries types rcodes srcs first
index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:http $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | fillnull value="(none)" method | stats count by method | sort - count
index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:http $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | fillnull value="(no reply)" status_code | stats count by status_code | sort - count
index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:http $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval mime=coalesce(mvindex(resp_mime_types,0),"(none)") | stats count by mime | sort - count

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:http $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval h=mvdedup(host) | stats count as requests dc(id_orig_h) as clients values(method) as methods dc(uri) as uris sum(response_body_len) as resp_bytes values(id_resp_h) as ips min(ts) as first by h | eval resp_KB=round(resp_bytes/1024,1) | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table h ips requests clients methods uris resp_KB first | sort - requests

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:http $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | fillnull value="(none)" user_agent | stats count as requests dc(id_orig_h) as clients values(id_orig_h) as srcs dc(host) as hosts min(ts) as first by user_agent | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort requests | table user_agent requests clients srcs hosts first

panel.title: F6. POST requests (data sent by the client)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:http $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") method=POST | sort 0 ts | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N"), h=mvdedup(host) | table time id_orig_h id_resp_h h uri request_body_len response_body_len status_code user_agent uid

panel.title: F7. Programs, scripts, archives and documents downloaded over HTTP

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:http $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval mime=mvjoin(resp_mime_types,","), h=mvdedup(host) | eval fname=lower(mvindex(split(mvindex(split(uri,"?"),0),"/"),-1)), ext=if(match(fname,"\."), mvindex(split(fname,"."),-1), "") | where match(mime,"dosexec|x-msdownload|x-executable|java-archive|x-shockwave-flash|zip|x-rar|7z|octet-stream|hta|x-ms-shortcut|msi|msword|ms-excel|ms-powerpoint|officedocument|rtf|pdf") OR match(ext,"^(exe|dll|scr|ps1|vbs|hta|bat|cmd|msi|jar|zip|rar|7z|iso|lnk|doc|docm|xls|xlsm|ppt|pptm|rtf|swf)$$") | eval mismatch=if(match(mime,"dosexec") AND NOT match(ext,"^(exe|dll|scr|sys|msi|com)$$"),"EXE under another name","") | sort 0 ts | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table time id_orig_h id_resp_h h uri mime response_body_len mismatch status_code uid

panel.title: F8. HTTP straight to an IP address or with no Host header

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:http $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval h=mvdedup(host) | where isnull(h) OR match(h,"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+(:\d+)?$$") | sort 0 ts | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table time id_orig_h id_resp_h id_resp_p h method uri status_code user_agent uid

panel.title: F9. Web timeline with referrer (follow the redirect chain)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:http $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | sort 0 ts | head 3000 | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N"), h=mvdedup(host), ref=replace(referrer,"^https?://",""), mime=mvindex(resp_mime_types,0) | table time id_orig_h method h uri ref status_code mime response_body_len user_agent uid
index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:ssl $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | fillnull value="(unknown)" version | stats count by version

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:ssl $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | fillnull value="(no SNI)" server_name | stats count as conns dc(id_orig_h) as clients values(id_resp_h) as ips values(id_resp_p) as ports values(version) as versions values(established) as established min(ts) as first by server_name | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - conns

panel.title: G3. TLS without a server name, or on a port other than 443

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:ssl $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | where isnull(server_name) OR id_resp_p!=443 | stats count as conns values(version) as versions values(established) as established min(ts) as first max(ts) as last by id_orig_h id_resp_h id_resp_p server_name | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - conns

panel.title: G4. Server certificates - self-signed and short-lived ones stand out

search.query: index=$idx$ $case$ (sourcetype=zeek:ssl OR sourcetype=zeek:x509) | eval fp=if(sourcetype="zeek:x509", fingerprint, mvindex(cert_chain_fps,0)) | where isnotnull(fp) | stats values(server_name) as sni values(id_resp_h) as ips count(eval(sourcetype="zeek:ssl")) as conns values(certificate_subject) as subject values(certificate_issuer) as issuer values(san_dns) as san min(certificate_not_valid_before) as nvb max(certificate_not_valid_after) as nva by fp | where conns>0 AND isnotnull(subject) | search ips="$ip$" | eval self_signed=if(mvjoin(subject,"")=mvjoin(issuer,""),"YES",""), days_valid=round((nva-nvb)/86400,0), not_before=strftime(nvb,"%Y-%m-%d"), not_after=strftime(nva,"%Y-%m-%d"), san=mvindex(san,0,4) | sort -self_signed, days_valid | table sni ips conns subject issuer self_signed days_valid not_before not_after san
index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:files $case$ (tx_hosts="$ip$" OR rx_hosts="$ip$") | fillnull value="(unknown)" mime_type | stats count by mime_type | sort - count
index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:files $case$ (tx_hosts="$ip$" OR rx_hosts="$ip$") | fillnull value="(unknown)" file_source | stats count by file_source

panel.title: H3. Programs, scripts, archives and documents seen in any protocol (with hashes)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:files $case$ (tx_hosts="$ip$" OR rx_hosts="$ip$") | eval fname=coalesce(filename,"") | where match(mime_type,"dosexec|x-msdownload|x-executable|java-archive|zip|x-rar|7z|x-msi|vnd.ms-cab|x-shockwave-flash|msword|ms-excel|ms-powerpoint|officedocument|rtf|pdf|x-ms-shortcut|iso9660") OR match(lower(fname),"\.(exe|dll|scr|ps1|vbs|js|hta|bat|cmd|msi|jar|lnk|iso|zip|rar|7z|docm|xlsm)$$") | sort 0 ts | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), KB=round(seen_bytes/1024,1), tx=mvjoin(tx_hosts,","), rx=mvjoin(rx_hosts,",") | table time file_source tx rx mime_type fname KB md5 sha1 sha256 fuid

panel.title: H4. Windows programs (PE) - compile time, 64-bit, signed

search.query: index=$idx$ $case$ (sourcetype=zeek:files OR sourcetype=zeek:pe) | eval f=if(sourcetype="zeek:pe", id, fuid) | stats values(tx_hosts) as tx values(rx_hosts) as rx values(file_source) as proto values(filename) as fname values(md5) as md5 values(sha256) as sha256 values(machine) as machine values(os) as os values(subsystem) as subsystem values(is_exe) as is_exe values(is_64bit) as is_64bit values(has_cert_table) as signed values(compile_ts) as compile_ts min(ts) as first by f | where isnotnull(machine) | search tx="$ip$" OR rx="$ip$" | eval compiled=strftime(compile_ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table first tx rx proto fname is_exe is_64bit machine subsystem compiled signed md5 sha256
index=$sidx$ sourcetype=snort:alert $case$ (src_ip="$ip$" OR dest_ip="$ip$") | stats count by msg | sort - count | head 15

panel.title: I2. Zeek weird - traffic that breaks protocol rules

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:weird $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | stats count min(ts) as first values(id_orig_h) as srcs values(id_resp_h) as dsts by name | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - count

panel.title: I3. Snort alerts in time order

search.query: index=$sidx$ sourcetype=snort:alert $case$ (src_ip="$ip$" OR dest_ip="$ip$") | sort 0 _time | eval time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table time sid msg src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port
index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:notice $case$ | sort 0 ts | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table time note msg sub src dst p uid

panel.title: J1. Activity timeline - every log in time order (set Host IP to focus; click a row to open its uid)

search.query: index=$idx$ $case$ (sourcetype=zeek:conn OR sourcetype=zeek:dns OR sourcetype=zeek:http OR sourcetype=zeek:ssl OR sourcetype=zeek:files OR sourcetype=zeek:smb_mapping OR sourcetype=zeek:smb_files OR sourcetype=zeek:dce_rpc OR sourcetype=zeek:ntlm OR sourcetype=zeek:kerberos) (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$" OR tx_hosts="$ip$" OR rx_hosts="$ip$") | eval log=replace(sourcetype,"zeek:","") | eval src=coalesce(id_orig_h, mvjoin(tx_hosts,",")), dst=coalesce(id_resp_h, mvjoin(rx_hosts,",")), dport=id_resp_p | eval what=case( log="conn", coalesce(proto,"")." ".coalesce(service,"-")." state=".coalesce(conn_state,"")." out=".coalesce(orig_bytes,0)." in=".coalesce(resp_bytes,0), log="dns", coalesce(qtype_name,"")." ".coalesce(query,"")." > ".coalesce(mvjoin(answers," "), rcode_name, ""), log="http", coalesce(method,"")." ".coalesce(mvdedup(host),"").coalesce(uri,"")." [".coalesce(status_code,"-")."]", log="ssl", "TLS ".coalesce(server_name,"(no SNI)")." ".coalesce(version,""), log="files", coalesce(file_source,"")." ".coalesce(mime_type,"")." ".coalesce(filename,"")." ".coalesce(seen_bytes,"")." B md5=".coalesce(md5,""), log="smb_mapping", "MAP ".coalesce(path,""), log="smb_files", replace(coalesce(action,""),"SMB::","")." ".coalesce(path,"")." ".coalesce(name,""), log="dce_rpc", "RPC ".coalesce(endpoint,"")."::".coalesce(operation,""), log="ntlm", "NTLM ".coalesce(username,"")."@".coalesce(domainname,"")." from ".coalesce(hostname,"")." success=".coalesce(success,""), log="kerberos", "KRB ".coalesce(request_type,"")." ".coalesce(client,"")." > ".coalesce(service,"")." ".coalesce(error_msg,"")) | sort 0 ts | head 5000 | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N") | table time log src dst dport what uid

panel.title: J2. Every Zeek log for the clicked connection (uid)

search.query: index=$idx$ $case$ (uid="$sel_uid$" OR conn_uids="$sel_uid$" OR uids="$sel_uid$") | sort 0 ts | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N") | table time sourcetype _raw
